MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration (built on the host, flattened for the GPU)\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mersenne Twister -- bit identical replacement for std::mt19937\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// Only the raw (untempered) state words are produced here; tempering and the\n// conversion to [0,1) floats happen on the GPU.  The three-loop form of the\n// twist has no short loop carried dependence, so the host compiler vectorizes\n// it and the generator easily keeps ahead of the ray tracing kernels.\n\nclass MtStream {\n    static constexpr int NN = 624;\n    static constexpr int MM = 397;\n    static constexpr uint32_t MATRIX_A = 0x9908b0dfu;\n    static constexpr uint32_t UPPER_MASK = 0x80000000u;\n    static constexpr uint32_t LOWER_MASK = 0x7fffffffu;\n\n    uint32_t mt[NN];\n    int pos;\n\n    void twist() {\n        int i;\n        uint32_t y;\n        for (i = 0; i < NN - MM; ++i) {\n            y = (mt[i] & UPPER_MASK) | (mt[i + 1] & LOWER_MASK);\n            mt[i] = mt[i + MM] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        for (; i < NN - 1; ++i) {\n            y = (mt[i] & UPPER_MASK) | (mt[i + 1] & LOWER_MASK);\n            mt[i] = mt[i + (MM - NN)] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        }\n        y = (mt[NN - 1] & UPPER_MASK) | (mt[0] & LOWER_MASK);\n        mt[NN - 1] = mt[MM - 1] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? MATRIX_A : 0u);\n        pos = 0;\n    }\n\npublic:\n    explicit MtStream(uint32_t s = 42) { seed(s); }\n\n    void seed(uint32_t s) {\n        mt[0] = s;\n        for (int i = 1; i < NN; ++i) {\n            mt[i] = 1812433253u * (mt[i - 1] ^ (mt[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n        }\n        pos = NN;  // forces a twist on the first draw, exactly like std::mt19937\n    }\n\n    // Append the next `count` raw state words to `out`.\n    void generate(uint32_t* out, size_t count) {\n        while (count > 0) {\n            if (pos == NN) twist();\n            size_t n = std::min(count, static_cast<size_t>(NN - pos));\n            std::memcpy(out, mt + pos, n * sizeof(uint32_t));\n            out += n;\n            pos += static_cast<int>(n);\n            count -= n;\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device side scene representation\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DevScene {\n    const float4* __restrict__ triA;    // xyz: vertex a\n    const float4* __restrict__ triAB;   // xyz: b - a\n    const float4* __restrict__ triAC;   // xyz: c - a\n    const float4* __restrict__ triN;    // xyz: face normal\n    const float4* __restrict__ nodeC;   // xyz: octree node center\n    const float4* __restrict__ nodeH;   // xyz: octree node half extent\n    const int* __restrict__ nodeChild;      // 8 entries per node, -1 = absent\n    const int* __restrict__ nodeTriStart;   // leaf: offset into nodeTriList\n    const int* __restrict__ nodeTriCount;   // leaf: number of triangles, 0 = inner node\n    const int* __restrict__ nodeTriList;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 xyz(const float4& v) { return make_float3(v.x, v.y, v.z); }\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator+(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator-(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator*(const float3& a, float s) {\n    return make_float3(a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator-(const float3& a) {\n    return make_float3(-a.x, -a.y, -a.z);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dot3(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 cross3(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);\n}\n\n// std::mt19937 tempering\n__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mtTemper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= y >> 11;\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= y >> 18;\n    return y;\n}\n\n// libstdc++ std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) over std::mt19937\n__device__ __forceinline__ float mtCanonical(uint32_t raw) {\n    float r = __uint2float_rn(mtTemper(raw)) * 2.3283064365386963e-10f;  // 2^-32\n    // std::generate_canonical clamps to nextafter(1, 0)\n    return r >= 1.0f ? 0x1.fffffep-1f : r;\n}\n\n// Möller-Trumbore, identical arithmetic to the sequential version\n__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleIntersect(const float3& orig, const float3& dir,\n                                                      const float3& v0, const float3& e1,\n                                                      const float3& e2) {\n    float3 pvec = cross3(dir, e2);\n    float det = dot3(e1, pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    float3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    float u = dot3(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    float3 qvec = cross3(tvec, e1);\n    float v = dot3(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    return dot3(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const float3& p1, const float3& p2,\n                                                 const float3& center, const float3& halfExtent) {\n    float3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    float3 c = (p1 + d) - center;\n    float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int OCTREE_STACK_SIZE = 96;\n\n// Is the segment from `from` to `to` blocked by a triangle other than src/dst?\n// The traversal visits exactly the leaves the recursive reference visits; since\n// the result is a pure OR over triangles the visiting order is irrelevant.\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const DevScene& s, const float3& from, const float3& to,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    float3 dir = to - from;\n    float rayLen = sqrtf(dot3(dir, dir));\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    float3 dirNorm = make_float3(dir.x / rayLen, dir.y / rayLen, dir.z / rayLen);\n\n    int stack[OCTREE_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root is entered without a bounding box test\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        int node = stack[--sp];\n        int cnt = s.nodeTriCount[node];\n        if (cnt > 0) {\n            int start = s.nodeTriStart[node];\n            for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {\n                int idx = s.nodeTriList[start + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                float dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, xyz(s.triA[idx]),\n                                                  xyz(s.triAB[idx]), xyz(s.triAC[idx]));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            const int* ch = s.nodeChild + node * 8;\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int cid = ch[c];\n                if (cid >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(from, to, xyz(s.nodeC[cid]), xyz(s.nodeH[cid]))) {\n                    stack[sp++] = cid;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float cosPhiDev(const float3& v, const float3& normal) {\n    float vNorm = sqrtf(dot3(v, v));\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(v, normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Tau: ceil(|center_i - center_j| / WAVE_SPEED), one thread per pair.\n__global__ void tauKernel(const float4* __restrict__ triCenter, int N, int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    int i = blockIdx.y;\n    size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j;\n    if (i == j) { tau[off] = 0; return; }\n    float3 d = xyz(triCenter[i]) - xyz(triCenter[j]);\n    float dist = sqrtf(dot3(d, d));\n    tau[off] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// Exclusive prefix sum, within one mesh row, of \"this pair consumes randomness\".\n// One block per row of the current chunk.\n__global__ void rowRankKernel(const uint32_t* __restrict__ maskBits, int N, int rowBase,\n                              uint32_t* __restrict__ rowRank, uint32_t* __restrict__ rowCount) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t sdata[256];\n    __shared__ uint32_t running;\n\n    const int local = blockIdx.x;\n    const int i = rowBase + local;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) running = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int base = 0; base < N; base += 256) {\n        int j = base + tid;\n        uint32_t m = 0;\n        if (j < N) {\n            size_t bit = static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j;\n            m = (maskBits[bit >> 5] >> (bit & 31)) & 1u;\n        }\n        sdata[tid] = m;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int d = 1; d < 256; d <<= 1) {\n            uint32_t t = (tid >= d) ? sdata[tid - d] : 0u;\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (tid >= d) sdata[tid] += t;\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n        uint32_t incl = sdata[tid];\n        uint32_t total = sdata[255];\n        if (j < N) rowRank[static_cast<size_t>(local) * N + j] = running + incl - m;\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (tid == 0) running += total;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) rowCount[local] = running;\n}\n\n// Form factors.  One thread per (i,j) pair; NUM_RAYS shadow rays each.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(128) void kijKernel(DevScene s, int N, int rowBase,\n                                                 unsigned long long rankBase,\n                                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ rowRank,\n                                                 const unsigned long long* __restrict__ rowStart,\n                                                 const uint32_t* __restrict__ maskBits,\n                                                 const uint4* __restrict__ rng,\n                                                 float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    int local = blockIdx.y;\n    int i = rowBase + local;\n\n    size_t off = static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j;\n    uint32_t m = (maskBits[off >> 5] >> (off & 31)) & 1u;\n    if (!m) { kij[off] = ZERO; return; }\n\n    unsigned long long rank = rowStart[i] + rowRank[static_cast<size_t>(local) * N + j];\n    const uint4* w = rng + (rank - rankBase) * NUM_RAYS;\n\n    const float3 aI = xyz(s.triA[i]), abI = xyz(s.triAB[i]), acI = xyz(s.triAC[i]);\n    const float3 aJ = xyz(s.triA[j]), abJ = xyz(s.triAB[j]), acJ = xyz(s.triAC[j]);\n    const float3 nI = xyz(s.triN[i]), nJ = xyz(s.triN[j]);\n\n    float acc = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        uint4 q = w[r];\n        float u1 = mtCanonical(q.x), v1 = mtCanonical(q.y);\n        float u2 = mtCanonical(q.z), v2 = mtCanonical(q.w);\n        if (u1 + v1 > 1.0f) { u1 = 1.0f - u1; v1 = 1.0f - v1; }\n        if (u2 + v2 > 1.0f) { u2 = 1.0f - u2; v2 = 1.0f - v2; }\n\n        float3 pI = aI + abI * u1 + acI * v1;\n        float3 pJ = aJ + abJ * u2 + acJ * v2;\n\n        float3 v = pJ - pI;\n        float distSqr = dot3(v, v);\n        // Cheap rejections first; they are order independent w.r.t. the\n        // visibility test, so the accumulated value is unchanged.\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        float cosPhiI = cosPhiDev(v, nI);\n        float cosPhiJ = cosPhiDev(-v, nJ);\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(s, pI, pJ, i, j)) continue;\n\n        acc += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kij[off] = acc * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// One timestep of the radiosity update; one thread per receiver triangle.\n// The j loop keeps the sequential summation order (and reads column-major\n// neighbours so consecutive threads touch consecutive addresses).\n__global__ void radiosityKernel(int N, int t,\n                                const float* __restrict__ kij,\n                                const int* __restrict__ tau,\n                                const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                                const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                                const float* __restrict__ radE,\n                                float* __restrict__ radB) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    float sumB = ZERO;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n        size_t sym = static_cast<size_t>(j) * N + i;  // tau/kij are read transposed\n        int tauij = tau[sym];\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n        float k = kij[sym];\n        if (k <= ZERO) continue;\n        float radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n        sumB += fminf(k * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i;\n    radB[o] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[o];\n}\n\n// Transpose an N x N matrix (kij is produced row-major, consumed column-major).\ntemplate <typename T>\n__global__ void transposeKernel(const T* __restrict__ in, T* __restrict__ out, int N) {\n    __shared__ T tile[32][33];\n    int x = blockIdx.x * 32 + threadIdx.x;\n    int y = blockIdx.y * 32 + threadIdx.y;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 32; k += 8) {\n        if (x < N && (y + k) < N) tile[threadIdx.y + k][threadIdx.x] = in[static_cast<size_t>(y + k) * N + x];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    x = blockIdx.y * 32 + threadIdx.x;\n    y = blockIdx.x * 32 + threadIdx.y;\n    for (int k = 0; k < 32; k += 8) {\n        if (x < N && (y + k) < N) out[static_cast<size_t>(y + k) * N + x] = tile[threadIdx.x][threadIdx.y + k];\n    }\n}\n\n// Cross correlation of every triangle's response against the source response.\n__global__ void correlationKernel(int N, int T, int sourceIndex,\n                                  const float* __restrict__ radB,\n                                  float* __restrict__ corr) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    int t = blockIdx.y;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    float sum = ZERO;\n    for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n        float pB = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt) * N + i];\n        float pS = radB[static_cast<size_t>(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n        sum += pS * pB;\n    }\n    corr[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = sum;\n}\n\n// Argmax over lags, first maximum wins (matches the sequential \">\" test).\n__global__ void argmaxKernel(int N, int T, const float* __restrict__ corr,\n                             float* __restrict__ distances) {\n    int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    float maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        float sum = corr[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i];\n        if (sum > maxCorr) { maxCorr = sum; bestT = t; }\n    }\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(bestT);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Flattened octree\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct FlatOctree {\n    std::vector<float4> center, half;\n    std::vector<int> child;      // 8 per node\n    std::vector<int> triStart, triCount;\n    std::vector<int> triList;\n    int maxDepth = 0;\n};\n\nstatic int flattenOctree(const Octree* n, FlatOctree& f, int depth) {\n    int id = static_cast<int>(f.center.size());\n    f.center.push_back(make_float4(n->center.x, n->center.y, n->center.z, 0.0f));\n    f.half.push_back(make_float4(n->halfExtent.x, n->halfExtent.y, n->halfExtent.z, 0.0f));\n    f.child.resize(static_cast<size_t>(id + 1) * 8, -1);\n    f.triStart.push_back(0);\n    f.triCount.push_back(0);\n    f.maxDepth = std::max(f.maxDepth, depth);\n\n    if (!n->triangleIndices.empty()) {\n        f.triStart[id] = static_cast<int>(f.triList.size());\n        f.triCount[id] = static_cast<int>(n->triangleIndices.size());\n        for (size_t idx : n->triangleIndices) f.triList.push_back(static_cast<int>(idx));\n    } else {\n        for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n            if (n->children[c]) {\n                int cid = flattenOctree(n->children[c].get(), f, depth + 1);\n                f.child[static_cast<size_t>(id) * 8 + c] = cid;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return id;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n    FlatOctree flat;                // GPU friendly copy of the octree\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // --- device resident state -------------------------------------------\n    DevScene scene{};\n    float4 *dTriA = nullptr, *dTriAB = nullptr, *dTriAC = nullptr, *dTriN = nullptr, *dTriCenter = nullptr;\n    float4 *dNodeC = nullptr, *dNodeH = nullptr;\n    int *dNodeChild = nullptr, *dNodeTriStart = nullptr, *dNodeTriCount = nullptr, *dNodeTriList = nullptr;\n    float *dKij = nullptr, *dKijT = nullptr;\n    int *dTau = nullptr, *dTauT = nullptr;\n    float *dAreas = nullptr, *dRho = nullptr, *dRadE = nullptr, *dRadB = nullptr;\n    float *dCorr = nullptr, *dDistances = nullptr;\n    uint32_t *dMaskBits = nullptr, *dRowRank = nullptr, *dRowCount = nullptr;\n    unsigned long long *dRowStart = nullptr;\n\n    // host side helpers for the randomness stream\n    std::vector<uint32_t> maskBits;\n    std::vector<unsigned long long> rowStart;   // global rank of the first pair of each row\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    flattenOctree(&state.octree, state.flat, 0);\n    if (state.flat.maxDepth * 8 + 1 > OCTREE_STACK_SIZE) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for the device traversal stack (%d)\\n\", state.flat.maxDepth);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- device\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const size_t numNodes = state.flat.center.size();\n\n    printf(\"Uploading scene to GPU (%zu octree nodes, %zu leaf references)...\\n\",\n           numNodes, state.flat.triList.size());\n\n    std::vector<float4> hA(N), hAB(N), hAC(N), hN(N), hC(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& tr = state.triangles[i];\n        Vec3 ab = tr.b - tr.a;\n        Vec3 ac = tr.c - tr.a;\n        Vec3 nn = tr.normal();\n        Vec3 cc = tr.center();\n        hA[i]  = make_float4(tr.a.x, tr.a.y, tr.a.z, 0.0f);\n        hAB[i] = make_float4(ab.x, ab.y, ab.z, 0.0f);\n        hAC[i] = make_float4(ac.x, ac.y, ac.z, 0.0f);\n        hN[i]  = make_float4(nn.x, nn.y, nn.z, 0.0f);\n        hC[i]  = make_float4(cc.x, cc.y, cc.z, 0.0f);\n    }\n\n    state.dTriA = devAlloc<float4>(N);\n    state.dTriAB = devAlloc<float4>(N);\n    state.dTriAC = devAlloc<float4>(N);\n    state.dTriN = devAlloc<float4>(N);\n    state.dTriCenter = devAlloc<float4>(N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriA, hA.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriAB, hAB.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriAC, hAC.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriN, hN.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriCenter, hC.data(), N * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    state.dNodeC = devAlloc<float4>(numNodes);\n    state.dNodeH = devAlloc<float4>(numNodes);\n    state.dNodeChild = devAlloc<int>(numNodes * 8);\n    state.dNodeTriStart = devAlloc<int>(numNodes);\n    state.dNodeTriCount = devAlloc<int>(numNodes);\n    state.dNodeTriList = devAlloc<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, state.flat.triList.size()));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeC, state.flat.center.data(), numNodes * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeH, state.flat.half.data(), numNodes * sizeof(float4), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeChild, state.flat.child.data(), numNodes * 8 * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeTriStart, state.flat.triStart.data(), numNodes * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeTriCount, state.flat.triCount.data(), numNodes * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!state.flat.triList.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodeTriList, state.flat.triList.data(),\n                              state.flat.triList.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    state.scene.triA = state.dTriA;\n    state.scene.triAB = state.dTriAB;\n    state.scene.triAC = state.dTriAC;\n    state.scene.triN = state.dTriN;\n    state.scene.nodeC = state.dNodeC;\n    state.scene.nodeH = state.dNodeH;\n    state.scene.nodeChild = state.dNodeChild;\n    state.scene.nodeTriStart = state.dNodeTriStart;\n    state.scene.nodeTriCount = state.dNodeTriCount;\n    state.scene.nodeTriList = state.dNodeTriList;\n\n    state.dKij = devAlloc<float>(N * N);\n    state.dKijT = devAlloc<float>(N * N);\n    state.dTau = devAlloc<int>(N * N);\n    state.dAreas = devAlloc<float>(N);\n    state.dRho = devAlloc<float>(N);\n    state.dRadE = devAlloc<float>(T * N);\n    state.dRadB = devAlloc<float>(T * N);\n    state.dCorr = devAlloc<float>(T * N);\n    state.dDistances = devAlloc<float>(N);\n    state.dRowStart = devAlloc<unsigned long long>(N);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(), T * N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, T * N * sizeof(float)));\n}\n\nvoid releaseSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    for (void* p : {(void*)state.dTriA, (void*)state.dTriAB, (void*)state.dTriAC, (void*)state.dTriN,\n                    (void*)state.dTriCenter, (void*)state.dNodeC, (void*)state.dNodeH,\n                    (void*)state.dNodeChild, (void*)state.dNodeTriStart, (void*)state.dNodeTriCount,\n                    (void*)state.dNodeTriList, (void*)state.dKij, (void*)state.dKijT, (void*)state.dTau,\n                    (void*)state.dAreas, (void*)state.dRho, (void*)state.dRadE, (void*)state.dRadB,\n                    (void*)state.dCorr, (void*)state.dDistances, (void*)state.dMaskBits,\n                    (void*)state.dRowRank, (void*)state.dRowCount, (void*)state.dRowStart}) {\n        if (p) cudaFree(p);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    dim3 block(256);\n    dim3 grid((N + 255) / 256, N);\n    tauKernel<<<grid, block>>>(state.dTriCenter, N, state.dTau);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Build the \"pair consumes randomness\" bit mask exactly as the sequential code\n// decides it (same expression, same rounding), so the random stream offsets are\n// guaranteed to line up.\nstatic void buildRandomnessMask(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    state.maskBits.assign((N * N + 31) / 32, 0u);\n    state.rowStart.assign(N + 1, 0ull);\n\n    unsigned long long running = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.rowStart[i] = running;\n        const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[i].normal();\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            if (nI.dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) continue;\n            size_t bit = i * N + j;\n            state.maskBits[bit >> 5] |= 1u << (bit & 31);\n            ++running;\n        }\n    }\n    state.rowStart[N] = running;\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const size_t Nz = state.numTriangles;\n\n    buildRandomnessMask(state);\n\n    state.dMaskBits = devAlloc<uint32_t>(state.maskBits.size());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dMaskBits, state.maskBits.data(),\n                          state.maskBits.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRowStart, state.rowStart.data(),\n                          Nz * sizeof(unsigned long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Chunk the mesh rows so that the random words for one chunk stay well below\n    // ~64 MB; that keeps enough chunks around for host/device pipelining.\n    const size_t wordsPerRow = Nz * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n    size_t rowsPerChunk = std::max<size_t>(1, (16u << 20) / std::max<size_t>(1, wordsPerRow));\n    rowsPerChunk = std::min(rowsPerChunk, std::max<size_t>(1, Nz / 8));\n    rowsPerChunk = std::min(rowsPerChunk, Nz);\n    const size_t chunkWords = rowsPerChunk * wordsPerRow;\n\n    state.dRowRank = devAlloc<uint32_t>(rowsPerChunk * Nz);\n    state.dRowCount = devAlloc<uint32_t>(rowsPerChunk);\n\n    constexpr int NBUF = 2;\n    uint32_t* hostRng[NBUF];\n    uint32_t* devRng[NBUF];\n    cudaStream_t stream[NBUF];\n    cudaEvent_t copyDone[NBUF];\n    for (int b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hostRng[b], chunkWords * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n        devRng[b] = devAlloc<uint32_t>(chunkWords);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&copyDone[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    MtStream mt(42);\n\n    dim3 block(128);\n    size_t chunkIdx = 0;\n    for (size_t rowBase = 0; rowBase < Nz; rowBase += rowsPerChunk, ++chunkIdx) {\n        const size_t rows = std::min(rowsPerChunk, Nz - rowBase);\n        const int b = static_cast<int>(chunkIdx % NBUF);\n        const unsigned long long rankBase = state.rowStart[rowBase];\n        const size_t words = (state.rowStart[rowBase + rows] - rankBase) * DRAWS_PER_PAIR;\n\n        // The pinned buffer can be refilled once its previous upload finished.\n        if (chunkIdx >= NBUF) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(copyDone[b]));\n\n        mt.generate(hostRng[b], words);\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(devRng[b], hostRng[b], words * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(copyDone[b], stream[b]));\n\n        rowRankKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(rows), 256, 0, stream[b]>>>(\n            state.dMaskBits, N, static_cast<int>(rowBase), state.dRowRank, state.dRowCount);\n\n        dim3 grid((N + block.x - 1) / block.x, static_cast<unsigned>(rows));\n        kijKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream[b]>>>(\n            state.scene, N, static_cast<int>(rowBase), rankBase, state.dRowRank,\n            state.dRowStart, state.dMaskBits,\n            reinterpret_cast<const uint4*>(devRng[b]), state.dKij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        for (size_t i = rowBase; i < rowBase + rows; ++i) {\n            if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == Nz) {\n                printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, Nz);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < NBUF; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hostRng[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(devRng[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(copyDone[b]));\n    }\n\n    // The radiosity kernel reads Kij column-major for coalescing.\n    dim3 tblock(32, 8);\n    dim3 tgrid((N + 31) / 32, (N + 31) / 32);\n    transposeKernel<float><<<tgrid, tblock>>>(state.dKij, state.dKijT, N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n    dim3 block(128);\n    dim3 grid((N + block.x - 1) / block.x);\n\n    for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        // Tau is symmetric, so the transposed read below is exact.\n        radiosityKernel<<<grid, block>>>(N, t, state.dKijT, state.dTau, state.dAreas,\n                                         state.dRho, state.dRadE, state.dRadB);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %d/%d\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);\n\n    dim3 block(128);\n    dim3 grid((N + block.x - 1) / block.x, static_cast<unsigned>(T));\n    correlationKernel<<<grid, block>>>(N, T, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex),\n                                       state.dRadB, state.dCorr);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    argmaxKernel<<<dim3((N + block.x - 1) / block.x), block>>>(N, T, state.dCorr, state.dDistances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.dDistances, N * sizeof(float),\n                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Pull the arrays that validation inspects back from the device.\nstatic void fetchValidationData(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.dKij, N * N * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.dRadB, T * N * sizeof(float),
